editor: human-reviewed public claim ledger; see evidence before publishing revisions

claims.claim: SCAD AI IDE is an independent open-source VS Code extension for OpenSCAD development.
qualifications: Not an official OpenSCAD, Microsoft or VS Code product.

claims.claim: OpenSCAD language support includes completion, diagnostics, navigation, rename and formatting through an LSP.
qualifications: A compatible LSP build may be required.

claims.claim: The installed extension provides interactive 3D preview, navigation, measurement, sections and export where supported.
qualifications: Supported operations depend on OpenSCAD CLI and rendering mode.

claims.claim: The public website demonstrates a precompiled STL cheese mesh in a Three.js viewer.
qualifications: The website does not embed VS Code or run an OpenSCAD compiler.

claims.claim: The extension manages discovery, installation and selection of OpenSCAD runtimes.
qualifications: Runtime availability depends on platform and supported builds.

claims.claim: Project libraries support exact dependency pins, restoration, versioned global storage and project-scoped OPENSCADPATH.
qualifications: No arbitrary version ranges or automatic recursive transitive dependency installation.

claims.claim: Customizer exposes parameter controls, presets and structured source edits with revision guards.
CAD tools provide CSG diagnostics, raw mesh inspection, frozen views, static assembly checks and report comparison.
qualifications: PASS/FAIL/UNRESOLVED apply to tested evidence; not a guarantee of printability or mechanical suitability.

claims.claim: 53 native VS Code Language Model Tools, 12 Skills and 2 Instructions are registered.
qualifications: Availability depends on VS Code Agent host/provider, permissions and trust.
Registration is not proof that autonomous CAD tasks pass end-to-end acceptance.

claims.claim: GUI commands and native Agent Tools reuse bounded IDE domain services and safety gates.
qualifications: Sensitive writes and destructive actions have independent authorization boundaries.

claims.claim: The extension does not currently ship an MCP server or bundled AI model.
qualifications: Native VS Code Language Model Tools can be used when the host/provider supports them.

claims.claim: The extension is available to run from source; there is no current official Marketplace listing or GitHub Release installer.
qualifications: VS Code >=1.140.0, Node.js 24, npm and Git are required; building LSP may require Rust/Cargo.

claims.claim: The repository is licensed under GPL-3.0.
qualifications: Future optional AI service pricing must not be conflated with source-code licensing.

claims.claim: Some non-ASCII paths fail with the tested Windows OpenSCAD CLI build.
qualifications: Upstream-vs-build root cause remains under investigation.

claims.claim: Experimental Fast CSG preview needs an additional Preview Exporter on supported macOS ARM64 systems.
qualifications: Does not represent stable all-platform functionality.
